subject: Request: Trial extension and sandbox credit due to integration delay
messages:
From: Alex Moreno <alex@finlytics.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Trial extension and sandbox credit due to integration delay

Hi Soojin,

Quick note from our side — we ran into an unexpected blocker on the FinLytics side while wiring up the Redwood connector. During our end-to-end tests over the weekend an upstream third-party changed the schema for transaction events and our ingestion pipeline started rejecting ~35% of payloads. That forced us to pause the adapter rollout so engineering can patch mapping logic and run a fresh test sweep.

We were planning to go live next week and continue our PoC, but this stall means our trial window will expire before we can exercise the relevant flows. Could you help with a 30-day trial extension and a small sandbox credit top-up so we can finish validation? At minimum we need another 3 weeks and ~100k tokens to re-run tests and iterate.

I've attached a short error snippet (integration-error-log-20280107.txt) so you have visibility.

Appreciate any help — want to avoid losing momentum on our side.

Thanks,
Alex Moreno
Head of Integrations | FinLytics Inc.
alex@finlytics.com
[Attachment: integration-error-log-20280107.txt]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Jan 2028 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Trial extension and sandbox credit due to integration delay

Hi Alex — thanks for the context and the log.

Sorry to hear about the schema drift; that can definitely derail a sprint. Ill escalate this internally and see what runway we can provide so you can finish validation without losing momentum.

Two quick asks from our side: 1) confirmed duration youre requesting (weeks/days), and 2) the minimum token amount youd need to complete the re-tests. You mentioned ~100k tokens — is that still the ask?

Im looping in Marissa (customer success) and Ben (sales ops) to expedite approvals. Well come back with a clear yes/no and any admin steps (DocuSign / amended SOW) by EOD tomorrow.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
Office: +1 (415) 555-0124

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Jan 2028 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: FW: Request: Trial extension and sandbox credit due to integration delay

Marissa / Ben — forwarding Alexs note. FinLytics hit a schema change upstream and they need time to patch; theyre asking for 30 days plus ~100k tokens to re-run tests. Deal DL-2028-017.

Suggested approach: approve a 30-day extension to their sandbox and issue a one-time 100k token credit for PoC usage. This keeps the PoC alive and preserves our chance to convert. If finance needs to gate any credit issuance, happy to route through a formal approval doc.

Key considerations:
- FinLytics is engineering-heavy and likely to convert once integration proves stable.
- We should tie the extension to a short mutual action plan (3 checkpoints during the 30 days) to keep cadence and measure progress.

Ben — can you confirm credit authority / any required approvals? If you want, I can draft the approval note for signature.

Thanks,
Soojin

Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Approved: 30-day sandbox extension + 100k token credit (DL-2028-017)

Hi Alex — good news. We approved a 30-day extension of your trial and issued a one-time 100,000 token sandbox credit for FinLytics PoC (deal DL-2028-017).

What this means:
- Trial window extended through 2028-02-09 (UTC).
- Sandbox credit of 100,000 tokens applied to your account; you should see the allocation in the console under Project -> Billing -> Credits.
- Weve attached a brief approval note (approval-note-30day-extension.pdf) for your records. No new billing or SOW is required for this one-time assistance. If you plan to convert to dedicated capacity after PoC, we can discuss committed terms and pricing.

Next steps:
1) Marissa will follow up with a 3-checkpoint mutual action plan template and schedule a short weekly sync for the next three weeks.
2) If you want the approval as a signed DocuSign, say the word and well route it.

If anything else comes up (more tokens, longer window), let me know and well evaluate on a case-by-case basis. Good luck with the patching — ping me if you want an engineer on a quick call to speed validation.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
